nextStoryContext: readMergeMode() is now the single source of truth for merge mode. Downstream stories (US-002: cam init sets/tests branch protection; US-003: ci-gated sidecar post-merge) must call readMergeMode() from src/config/models.ts. The function lives next to readPhaseModel and readBackend; the MergeMode type is exported from the same module.
